## ProofsModule.getRequestedCredentialsForProofRequest() method

Create a [RetrievedCredentials](./core.retrievedcredentials.md) object. Given input proof request and presentation proposal, use credentials in the wallet to build indy requested credentials object for input to proof creation. If restrictions allow, self attested attributes will be used.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
getRequestedCredentialsForProofRequest(proofRecordId: string, config?: GetRequestedCredentialsConfig): Promise<RetrievedCredentials>;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  proofRecordId | string | the id of the proof request to get the matching credentials for |
|  config | [GetRequestedCredentialsConfig](./core.getrequestedcredentialsconfig.md) | <i>(Optional)</i> optional configuration for credential selection process. Use <code>filterByPresentationPreview</code> (default <code>true</code>) to only include credentials that match the presentation preview from the presentation proposal (if available). |

Promise&lt;[RetrievedCredentials](./core.retrievedcredentials.md)<!-- -->&gt;
